story_zh: 昨天，我在街上看到一个老人突然摔倒。我马上跑过去帮助他。他看起来很痛苦，所以我打电话叫了救护车。在医院，医生帮助他检查身体。老人非常感谢我的帮助。
story_pinyin: Zuótiān, wǒ zài jiē shàng kàn dào yīgè lǎorén túrán shuāidǎo. Wǒ mǎshàng pǎo guòqù bāngzhù tā. Tā kàn qǐlái hěn tòngkǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎ diànhuà jiào le jiùhùchē. Zài yīyuàn, yīshēng bāngzhù tā jiǎnchá shēntǐ. Lǎorén fēicháng gǎnxiè wǒ de bāngzhù.
story_en: Yesterday, I saw an old man suddenly fall on the street. I immediately ran over to help him. He looked very painful, so I called an ambulance. At the hospital, the doctor helped him check his body. The old man was very grateful for my help.
